تصادرت (form VI)
# تَصَادَرْتُ (taṣādartu) /ta.sˤaː.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# تَصَادَرْتَ (taṣādarta) /ta.sˤaː.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# تَصَادَرْتِ (taṣādarti) /ta.sˤaː.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# تَصَادَرَتْ (taṣādarat) /ta.sˤaː.da.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
